assay.organism_kind: Gram-positive bacterium, model strain (NOT a cell line)
assay.cargo: none -- the lipidoid is tested as the compound itself; there is no nucleic acid, no helper lipid, no PEG-lipid and no nanoparticle in this assay
assay.formulation: methylated (quaternised) lipidoid dispersed directly in Luria Broth growth medium; DLS shows 100-1000 nm aggregates for most members (Figure S2)
assay.route: in vitro, liquid broth growth-inhibition assay (bioscreen OD)
assay.readout_as_printed: optical density at 420-580 nm (OD420-580) of planktonic bacteria
assay.activity_definition: >99.9% inhibition of growth, evidenced either by complete lack of growth over 24 h or by a significantly delayed onset of the log phase; the 150 min delay threshold is derived in Figure S3

note: printed_tail_totals_tableS3 is recorded because it CONTRADICTS the cells it totals; see 08_contradictions.csv C-1.
